subject.title: fix(signal): expose mention facts in inbound context

question: Should OpenClaw promote these delivered-turn Signal mention facts into the generic plugin SDK `MsgContext` after the native Signal mention-gating prerequisite lands?
rationale: The implementation is additive and appears coherent, but public plugin SDK context fields become a third-party contract and need maintainer acceptance beyond automated correctness review.

options.title: Accept additive context contract
options.body: Merge the prerequisite first, then land this PR with the proposed `MsgContext` fields and `MentionSource: "native"` contract after checks stay green.

options.title: Keep facts Signal-local
options.body: Ask for a narrower Signal-local diagnostics path if maintainers do not want these fields in the public plugin SDK context yet.

options.title: Narrow the field set
options.body: Request a smaller public contract if only some of the proposed mention facts are worth exposing to plugins and prompts.

recommendation.title: Accept additive context contract
recommendation.body: Merge the prerequisite first, then land this PR with the proposed `MsgContext` fields and `MentionSource: "native"` contract after checks stay green.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on shared inbound context and plugin SDK-adjacent refactors among the inspected owners.
